high_level_description: The image depicts a square ceramic tile with an intricate and colorful design. The tile is predominantly blue with a white border. At the center of the tile is a symmetrical pattern featuring a large, central flower with a yellow center and blue petals. Surrounding this central flower are smaller flowers in pink and yellow, each with green leaves and stems. The outer edges of the tile are adorned with additional floral motifs, including more pink and yellow flowers with green leaves.
